description: This file defines a Catalyst controller for managing 'Unit' entities within a project, including actions for listing, editing, creating, updating, deleting units, and managing unit conversions.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Unit
classes.description: Controller class for managing units within the Coocook project, handling CRUD operations and unit conversions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list units, including their usage and conversions.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures a unit by ID and sets it in the stash, or detaches with an error if not found.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific unit, including related articles, conversions, and grouped units.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new unit related to the project and proceeds to update or insert.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing unit.

methods.name: update_or_insert
methods.description: Performs the actual update or insertion of a unit, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: add_conversion
methods.description: Adds a new conversion between units.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to the appropriate page after operations.
